'''Premiere &ndash; Endor''' (display name '''Premiere - Endor''') is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]].

The [[1999 Decipher World Championship]] at DecipherCon in Virginia Beach was played in this format.

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
